name: Jaroslav Novák
bio: Jaroslav Novák has been navigating the complex world of motorsports finance for over 15 years. Starting as a junior accountant for a small rally team, he quickly rose through the ranks due to his meticulous attention to detail and uncanny ability to identify cost-saving opportunities. Jaroslav believes that financial stability is the bedrock upon which racing success is built, and he approaches his role with a strategic vision that extends beyond mere number crunching. He sees the potential for innovation in financial management and is always looking for new ways to optimize budgets and maximize return on investment, allowing the team to push the boundaries of performance.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jaroslav is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a lucky coin from his grandfather.
Insists on using a specific brand of green highlighter for budget reviews.
Has a habit of muttering calculations under his breath during races.
